SEN.note: Tax agency platform only; no multi-service government portal stated.

facts.fact: The DGID says SENTAX is its platform for online filing and payment (télépaiement) of taxes, mandatory for all declarations and payments of Large Enterprise Directorate taxpayers from 1 September 2026.

systems.owner: Direction générale des Impôts et des Domaines

facts.fact: The DGID says SENTAX is its online platform for tax filing (télédéclaration), replacing ETAX for large-enterprise taxpayers.
The DGID says SENTAX handles online payment (télépaiement) of taxes and levies.

The DGID says use of SENTAX is mandatory and paper returns are no longer accepted for Large Enterprise Directorate taxpayers from 1 September 2026, and for the Dakar medium-enterprise centres and regulated professions centre from 1 October 2026.

facts.fact: The DGID says taxpayers can register online (immatriculation en ligne) through SENTAX, with membership requests validated by DGID services.
